subject: Geospatial model evaluation
body:
Hi Martha,

I'm a UofT student on co-op in London, UK, working on search, planning and simulation for biotech automation, mostly around failure and recovery in large systems. I've also done a fair bit with RL and MCTS.

I’d like to do more work on finding where a model stops being reliable, which is what drew me to Development Seed’s geospatial work. I was thinking about models that work well on one set of imagery but behave differently when the region, sensor or available coverage changes.

I was wondering if there might be a project I could take ownership of alongside my current work. One thought was evaluation tooling to test how a geospatial model behaves across regions and with missing imagery or changing sensor conditions, but I’d much rather work on whatever problem would actually be useful to your team.

I attached my resume for context; happy to talk if there might be something worth exploring.

Best,
Andrew
